bindings.statement: Distributed-systems logical or process-local ordering is not automatically relativistic proper time.
TRANSPORT_ACK and application-level EFFECT_ACK are distinct protocol concepts in the QIK-VRT primary-source mapping; no IETF consensus is implied.
Reconstruction from later-arriving evidence does not by itself imply physical backward-time transport or mutation of an earlier event.
The QIK-VRT universal-understanding thesis remains explicitly project-specific and not established scientific consensus.
No physical time machine, reception before emission, backward-running relativistic proper time, or controllable signalling into one's own causal past is claimed by this publication bundle.
